title: Project settings
description: Manage stable project identity, promotion targets, and lifecycle controls.

general.title: General
general.description: Update the project name and review its stable automation identity.
general.readOnlyDescription: Only workspace owners, administrators, and leads can change project settings.
general.savedDescription: The project display name is up to date.
general.name: Project name
general.nameInvalid: Enter a project name up to 120 characters.
general.keyHint: Stable identifier used in case references and automation.
general.slugHint: Stable URL identifier. Renaming requires permanent redirect support and is not available yet.
general.identityDescription: The project key and URL remain immutable so case references, API clients, CI jobs, and deep links stay valid.
general.archiveDescription: Archive this project when work has ended. History is preserved, but all draft and active runs must be closed first.
general.confirmArchiveMessage: The project leaves active navigation and stops accepting new work. Existing history remains available for recovery.

environments.title: Environments
environments.description: Manage logical promotion targets for this project. Environments are not deployment records.
environments.createDescription: Give the promotion target a stable name and URL-safe identifier.
environments.name: Name
environments.nameInvalid: Enter an environment name up to 120 characters.
environments.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens; for example production-eu.
environments.slugInvalid: Enter a valid environment slug up to 50 characters.
environments.descriptionHint: Optional context about what this promotion target represents.
environments.emptyDescription: Create a logical target such as Development, Staging, or Production.
environments.readOnlyDescription: Only workspace owners, administrators, and leads can create or change environments.

confirm.archiveMessage: Archived environments cannot receive new releases. Existing release history is preserved.
confirm.restoreMessage: The environment will become available for new releases again.
